definitions.explanation: The protective case or sheath for a Japanese sword. An essential component of a complete sword mounting, traditionally made of wood with a lacquered finish.

examples.japanese: {刀鞘|かたなざや}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いた→抜く：02384_nuku⟧。
examples.english: He drew the sword from its sheath.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{刀鞘|かたなざや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漆|うるし}→漆：10584_urushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}られている→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: This scabbard is beautifully coated with lacquer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名工|めいこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧{刀鞘|かたなざや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コレクション→コレクション：07327_korekushon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The museum displays a collection of scabbards made by master craftsmen of the Edo period.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧ (sword) and ⟦{鞘|さや}→鞘：14698_saya⟧ (sheath). The ⟦{鞘|さや}→鞘：14698_saya⟧ is one of the key components of a Japanese sword's {拵|こしらえ} (mounting), along with the {柄|つか} (handle) and {鍔|つば} (guard).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刀鞘|かたなざや}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: draw from the scabbard
- {刀鞘|かたなざや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧: sheathe (a sword)
- {漆塗|うるしぬ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刀鞘|かたなざや}: lacquered scabbard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鞘|さや}→鞘：14698_saya⟧: sheath (general term, used alone for any sheath or scabbard)
- {拵|こしらえ}: sword mounting (the full set of fittings for a Japanese sword)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional Japanese sword scabbards are made from {朴|ほお}の{木|き} (magnolia wood) and often finished with elaborate lacquerwork. Fine scabbards are considered works of art in their own right and are valued by collectors.
